verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages show a startup practice that serves companies from incubation onward and offers a first-party German Incorporation Questionnaire. A community customer reports Orrick handled their Delaware C-corp incorporation, but no first-party page describes incorporation as a core engagement or lists the specific deliverables. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of incorporation as a core service, explicit coverage of charter, bylaws, initial board consents and founder stock purchase agreements, and US formation-specific detail.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice

citations.quote: They helped me tremendously with my incorporation (c-corp Delaware)
Our venture capital team advises companies and investors at all stages of growth from incubation through to exit
I used these docs in 2010 to form my company
